name: 7 Keys Saga
summary: 7 Keys Saga is a top-down 2D action RPG where you embark on a quest to find seven mystical keys scattered across a dangerous world.

name: 7Komada
summary: A social deduction death game set in a backwater of alternate universe Europe. You and your class's graduation trip has been cut short by a novel 19-man kidnapping - and as you all wake up trapped in an abandoned mansion, you take it upon yourself to figure out what's going on before it's too late.
